values.description: Spring Cloud Gateway (port 8085). Now the ONLY public entry point: routes /api/payments/**, /api/accounts/**, /api/configs/** and /api/cards/** (→ payment-service) and /api/fraud/** (→ fraud-service). Requires a Keycloak Bearer token on every call.
Eureka registry (web UI + /eureka/apps). Not behind the gateway; no auth.
Spring Cloud Config Server. Not behind the gateway; no auth.
Kafka UI (topics, consumer lag, consumer groups). Not behind the gateway; no auth.
Keycloak (admin console admin/admin). Realm token endpoint: {{keycloakUrl}}/realms/{{realm}}/protocol/openid-connect/token
Keycloak realm name. MUST be exactly 'paytrack' — it is hardcoded in the gateway (jwk-set-uri) and in the config-server files for payment-service and fraud-service.
Keycloak client. Create it (access type public) and enable Direct Access Grants so the password grant works for manual testing.
Keycloak username of a test user (create one in the realm).
JWT access token. Filled automatically by the 'Keycloak Auth > Get Access Token' request. Used as the Bearer token on every API call via collection-level auth.
